snippet.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 - Scag® Roster Reveal!!
snippet.description:
We're delighted to announce the official Scag® mowers for Lawn Mowing Simulator 2!

We'll have plenty more as we build up to our Kickstarter campaign, so don't forget to follow the page!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skyhookgames/lawn-mowing-simulator-2?ref=8ggfvk

P.S.
This is IRL footage, not in-game!

Click here to join our Discord - https://discord.gg/U5d5pwec
